summary: The old harness can select the new spoiler flag and supply spoiler syntax. Its output callback discards HTML, but retaining output is not a source requirement. Overall coverage remains incomplete because the delegated build configuration and document-processing call path were not supplied.

claims.necessity_reason: The entry reads arbitrary parser flags from the input and passes the remaining bytes to md_html. An input can set MD_FLAG_SPOILERS and supply ||text||, so the new behavior has a route through the old harness.

before.requirement: Recognize a spoiler span when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is set.
before.reason: The complete before span enum and mark collector have no spoiler span or double-pipe recognition.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before collector treats pipes only as table or wiki-link marks.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS, recognize ||text|| and render the span with x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The flag is a bit in the parser flags that the harness takes from input. Its remaining input bytes can contain the double-pipe syntax; the parser resolves the span and the HTML callbacks emit its tags.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The flag enables collection of double-pipe marks.
Collected double-pipe marks are analyzed as spoiler delimiters.
Resolved delimiters generate spoiler span callbacks.
The opening callback emits the spoiler tag.
The closing callback emits the matching tag.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: md_html passes the supplied parser flags to md_parse.

claims.comparison_reason: This spoiler obligation did not apply before the change and is reachable through the same old harness afterward.

claims.necessity_reason: md_html takes an output callback, but the supplied source imposes no requirement to retain its chunks. The harness supplies a callback; retaining or asserting on its output would add a harness check.

before.requirement: Retain emitted HTML chunks for later inspection.
before.reason: The complete md_html function accepts and passes through a caller-provided output callback without requiring storage of its output.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: md_html invokes parsing with the configured callback.

after.requirement: Retain emitted HTML chunks for later inspection.
after.reason: The unchanged md_html callback contract still does not require the caller to store output.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: md_html invokes parsing with the configured callback.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The entry supplies that callback to md_html and makes no output assertion.

claims.comparison_reason: The callback discards output on both sides, but output retention is not a required obligation on either side.

missing_information: The complete src/CMakeLists.txt is needed to verify the libraries and compile configuration delegated by the supplied build recipe.
The complete src/md4c.c::md_process_doc call path is needed to finish tracing md_parse through document processing and establish full control-flow coverage.
